findings.observation: Crisis identification has the largest remaining gap in this synthetic sample.
findings.interpretation: The example illustrates how a self-reported gap can guide a review of training content.

notes: All values in this fixture use fictional data.

definitions.paired_coverage: Share of eligible responses with valid recalled-before and current ratings for the skill.
definitions.agree_before: Share selecting Agree or Strongly agree in the recalled-before rating.
definitions.agree_after: Share selecting Agree or Strongly agree in the current rating.
definitions.movement_up: Share with a higher current rating than recalled-before rating.
definitions.movement_same: Share with equal current and recalled-before ratings.
definitions.movement_down: Share with a lower current rating than recalled-before rating.
definitions.below_agree_after: Share selecting below Agree in the current rating.
definitions.ceiling_share: Share selecting Strongly agree in the recalled-before rating.
definitions.agreement_gain: Current agreement share minus recalled-before agreement share, in percentage points.
definitions.mean_ordinal_change: Mean current minus recalled-before ordinal rating in paired responses.
definitions.normalized_gain: Mean paired change divided by available rating points for each response with a recalled-before rating below 5. Negative changes are included.
definitions.wilcoxon_statistic: Smaller of the two sums of signed-rank magnitudes for nonzero paired changes.
definitions.wilcoxon_p_value: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value for symmetry of nonzero paired changes around zero.
definitions.rank_biserial: Matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation. The positive rank sum minus the negative rank sum, divided by total rank magnitude. Ties in absolute change receive average ranks.
definitions.sign_test_statistic: Number of positive paired changes in the exact sign test.
definitions.sign_test_p_value: Two-sided exact sign test p-value for equally likely positive and negative changes among changed pairs.
definitions.mcnemar_statistic: Smaller count of the two directions of paired change across Agree.
definitions.mcnemar_p_value: Two-sided exact McNemar p-value for equally likely directions of change among pairs that cross the Agree threshold.
definitions.large_reversal: Count of Strongly agree recalled-before ratings followed by Strongly disagree current ratings. A large reversal is a review flag.
definitions.transition_count: Count of complete pairs for the displayed recalled-before and current ratings.
definitions.gap_rank: Rank by share below Agree in the current rating, highest gap first. Tied skills share the same rank.
definitions.gain_rank: Rank by percentage-point increase in agreement, highest increase first. Tied skills share the same rank.
definitions.flag_sensitivity_delta: Change in a share when flagged responses are excluded, in percentage points.
definitions.usable_responses: Number of rows with a usable response ID.
definitions.flagged_responses: Number of rows with at least one response-quality flag.
definitions.invalid_training_dates: Number of training dates that failed to parse.
definitions.theme_answered: Number of valid answers to this comment question.
definitions.theme_prevalence: Share of valid answers assigned to this theme.
definitions.calling_coverage: Valid calling answers divided by eligible survey responses.
definitions.subgroup_response_count: Usable responses assigned to this subgroup.

caveats.label: Retrospective ratings
caveats.explanation: Respondents recalled their earlier ratings after the training.

caveats.label: Response-shift bias
caveats.explanation: Training may change how respondents interpret the rating scale.

caveats.label: Ceiling effects
caveats.explanation: Respondents starting at the top of the scale have no room to report an increase.

caveats.label: Nonresponse and self-selection
caveats.explanation: People who answer may differ from those who leave an item blank or do not take the survey.

caveats.label: Student-dominated sample
caveats.explanation: Students account for most responses in the reference survey.

caveats.label: Survey version drift
caveats.explanation: Item coverage can vary across training dates.

caveats.label: Stated intent
caveats.explanation: Reported willingness to call 988 measures intent.

caveats.label: No control group
caveats.explanation: The design supports description of self-reported change and associations.
